summary: A Depth subscription: a five-level book, then a book of three bids and two asks, then a full packet with no book at all (every level gone).

notes: The third packet has no book levels. Both sides publish its Depth frame with no depth key (wire-3's book_absent): never the connection's last book, since proto3 cannot tell an empty level list from one not sent and a cleared book shown as the old one is ghost liquidity (lead ruling 2026-11-09). Live check: does HDFC's empty book list mean unchanged or cleared.
Both sides send the levels the packet carried (three bids, two asks), at most five a side: MarketDepthDTOList.marketDepthDTO is a repeated field with no fixed slots.

deviations.reason: HDFC Sky sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

A cash equity's packet carries no OI (proto3 writes oi 0); the web sends that 0 as oi and open_interest instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). The desktop counts OI on the derivative segments only. Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.
